title: Article
subtitle: SSC CGL Tier 1 + Tier 2 Complete Notes

definition.english: An Article is a word placed before a noun to indicate whether the noun is specific or non-specific. Articles are considered a type of adjective because they modify nouns.
definition.marathi: Noun पूर्वी येऊन त्या Noun बद्दल विशिष्ट (Specific) किंवा सामान्य (General) माहिती देणाऱ्या शब्दांना Article म्हणतात.

types.name: Indefinite Article (A / An)
types.english: Used for any one person, place or thing.
types.marathi: एखाद्या सामान्य (Non-Specific) व्यक्ती, वस्तू किंवा स्थळासाठी वापरतात.

types.name: Definite Article (The)
types.english: Used for a particular or specific noun.
types.marathi: विशिष्ट व्यक्ती, वस्तू किंवा स्थळासाठी वापरतात.

goldenConcept.title: SSC Golden Concept: Sound vs Alphabet
goldenConcept.english: Article usage depends on the pronunciation (sound), not the alphabet the word starts with.
goldenConcept.marathi: Article हा Alphabet वर नाही तर Sound (उच्चार) वर अवलंबून असतो.

tables.title: SSC Exceptions: Without Article vs With Article
Few / A Few / Little / A Little

rules.title: Use A - Consonant Sound
rules.english: Use A before words beginning with a consonant sound.
rules.marathi: व्यंजनाच्या उच्चाराने सुरू होणाऱ्या शब्दांपूर्वी A वापरतात.

rules.title: Use AN - Vowel Sound
rules.english: Use An before words beginning with a vowel sound.
rules.marathi: स्वराच्या उच्चाराने सुरू होणाऱ्या शब्दांपूर्वी An वापरतात.

rules.title: A/An = One
rules.english: A / An means 'one'.
rules.marathi: A किंवा An चा अर्थ एक असा होतो.

rules.title: Never With Plural Noun
rules.english: A/An is never used before plural nouns.
rules.marathi: Plural Noun पूर्वी A किंवा An वापरत नाहीत.

rules.title: Never With Uncountable Nouns
rules.english: A/An is not used before uncountable nouns.
rules.marathi: Uncountable Noun पूर्वी A किंवा An वापरत नाहीत.

rules.title: Silent H -> Use AN
rules.english: If H is silent, use AN.
rules.marathi: H चा उच्चार होत नसेल तर An वापरतात.

rules.title: Sound of YU -> Use A
rules.english: Words beginning with vowel letters but consonant sound (/juː/) take A.
rules.marathi: Vowel letter असला तरी उच्चार 'यु' असल्यास A वापरतात.

rules.title: Words Beginning With One
rules.english: One begins with /w/ sound.
rules.marathi: One चा उच्चार 'वन' असल्यामुळे A वापरतात.

rules.title: Words Beginning With O But Consonant Sound
rules.english: If O has a consonant sound, use A.
rules.marathi: O ने सुरुवात झाली तरी स्वराचा उच्चार नसल्यास A वापरतात.

rules.title: Abbreviations
rules.english: Use the article according to the pronunciation of the first letter.
rules.marathi: Short Form (Abbreviation) मध्ये पहिल्या अक्षराच्या उच्चारानुसार Article वापरतात.

rules.title: Before Adjective + Noun
rules.english: Article depends on the pronunciation of the adjective, not the noun.
rules.marathi: Article हा Noun वर नाही तर आधी आलेल्या Adjective च्या उच्चारावर ठरतो.

rules.title: Before Profession
rules.english: Use A/An before professions.
rules.marathi: Profession किंवा Occupation पूर्वी A/An वापरतात.

rules.title: Before Singular Countable Noun
rules.english: A singular countable noun generally requires an article.
rules.marathi: Singular Countable Noun पूर्वी Article आवश्यक असतो.

rules.title: Exclamatory Sentences
rules.english: Use A/An after What or Such with singular countable nouns.
rules.marathi: What किंवा Such नंतर Singular Countable Noun आल्यास A/An वापरतात.

rules.title: Rate / Price / Speed
rules.english: A/An is used to express rate.
rules.marathi: Rate, Price, Speed दाखवताना A वापरतात.

rules.title: Previously Mentioned Noun
rules.english: Use The when the noun has already been mentioned.
rules.marathi: एकदा उल्लेख केलेल्या Noun साठी पुन्हा The वापरतात.
examples: I saw a dog. The dog was barking.

rules.title: Unique Things
rules.english: Use The before things that are unique.
rules.marathi: जगात एकच असलेल्या गोष्टींसमोर The वापरतात.

rules.title: Superlative Degree
rules.english: The is always used before Superlative Degree.
rules.marathi: Superlative Degree पूर्वी नेहमी The येतो.

rules.title: Ordinal Numbers
rules.english: Use The before ordinal numbers.
rules.marathi: First, Second, Third... पूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Musical Instruments
rules.english: Use The before the names of musical instruments.
rules.marathi: वाद्यांच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Holy / Religious Books
rules.english: Use The before religious books.
rules.marathi: धार्मिक ग्रंथांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Newspapers
rules.english: Use The before newspapers.
rules.marathi: वृत्तपत्रांच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Rivers
rules.english: Use The before rivers.
rules.marathi: नद्यांच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Oceans & Seas
rules.english: Use The before oceans and seas.
rules.marathi: महासागर व समुद्रांच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Mountain Ranges
rules.english: Use The before mountain ranges.
rules.marathi: पर्वतरांगांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Deserts
rules.english: Use The before deserts.
rules.marathi: वाळवंटांच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Group of Islands
rules.english: Use The before groups of islands.
rules.marathi: बेटांच्या समूहापूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Directions
rules.english: Use The when direction indicates a region.
rules.marathi: Direction प्रदेश दर्शवत असल्यास The वापरतात.

rules.title: Adjective Representing Whole Class
rules.english: The + Adjective = Entire Class.
rules.marathi: The + Adjective म्हणजे त्या वर्गातील सर्व लोक.

rules.title: Nationality
rules.english: Use The before nationality representing the whole nation.
rules.marathi: संपूर्ण राष्ट्र दर्शवताना The वापरतात.

rules.title: Inventions
rules.english: Use The before inventions.
rules.marathi: शोध/आविष्कारांसमोर The वापरतात.

rules.title: Whole Species
rules.english: The + Singular Noun represents the whole species.
rules.marathi: एकाच Noun द्वारे संपूर्ण जातीचा उल्लेख.
examples: The tiger is a dangerous animal.

rules.title: Proper Noun With Description
rules.english: Use The when a Proper Noun is qualified.
rules.marathi: Proper Noun बद्दल अतिरिक्त माहिती दिल्यास The वापरतात.

rules.title: Offices / Posts
rules.english: Use The before official positions.
rules.marathi: पदनामांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

wrongRight.right: The Prime Minister addressed the nation.

rules.title: Families
rules.english: The + Family Name = Entire Family.
rules.marathi: पूर्ण कुटुंब दर्शवताना The वापरतात.

rules.title: Same / Only
rules.english: Use The before Same and Only.
rules.marathi: Same आणि Only पूर्वी The येतो.

rules.title: Comparative (The...The)
rules.english: The + Comparative, The + Comparative.
examples: The more you read, the more you learn.

rules.title: Important Buildings
rules.english: Use The before famous buildings and monuments.
rules.marathi: प्रसिद्ध इमारतींपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Hotels / Cinemas / Museums
rules.english: Use The before hotels, cinemas and museums.
rules.marathi: हॉटेल्स, सिनेमा, संग्रहालयांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Ships / Trains / Aircraft
rules.english: Use The before names of ships, trains and aircraft.
rules.marathi: जहाज, ट्रेन, विमानांच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Proper Noun - Zero Article
rules.english: Do not use an article before Proper Nouns.
rules.marathi: Proper Noun पूर्वी सामान्यतः Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Languages - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before names of languages.
rules.marathi: भाषांच्या नावांपूर्वी Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Academic Subjects - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before subjects.
rules.marathi: विषयांच्या नावांपूर्वी Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Games & Sports - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before games.
rules.marathi: खेळांच्या नावांपूर्वी Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Meals - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before meals.
rules.marathi: जेवणांच्या नावांपूर्वी Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Days & Months - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before days and months.
rules.marathi: वार आणि महिन्यांच्या नावांपूर्वी Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Festivals - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before festivals.
rules.marathi: सणांच्या नावांपूर्वी Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Relations - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before relations used as proper names.
rules.marathi: आई, वडील इत्यादी संबोधन म्हणून वापरल्यास Article नाही.
examples: The father of the boy is a teacher.

rules.title: Transport (By) - Zero Article
rules.english: No article after By before means of transport.
rules.marathi: By नंतर वाहनाचे नाव आल्यास Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Fixed Phrases With By
rules.english: No article in fixed 'by' expressions.
rules.marathi: या वाक्प्रचारांमध्ये Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Home - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before Home when used as destination.
rules.marathi: Home पूर्वी सामान्यतः Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Bed - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when bed is used for sleeping.
rules.marathi: झोपण्यासाठी Bed वापरल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: School - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when school is used for studying.
rules.marathi: शिकण्यासाठी School वापरल्यास Article नाही.
examples: I went to the school to meet the Principal.

rules.title: College - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when in college as a student.
rules.marathi: विद्यार्थी म्हणून College असल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Hospital - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when admitted for treatment.
rules.marathi: उपचारासाठी Hospital असल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Prison / Jail - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when someone is imprisoned.
rules.marathi: कैदेसाठी Prison वापरल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Church / Temple / Mosque - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when used for worship.
rules.marathi: पूजेसाठी वापरल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Market - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when market is used generally.
rules.marathi: साधारण अर्थाने Market वापरल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Man / Woman (General Sense)
rules.english: No article in a general sense.
rules.marathi: संपूर्ण मानवजातीचा उल्लेख असल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Abstract Noun (General)
rules.english: No article before abstract nouns in general sense.
rules.marathi: Abstract Noun सामान्य अर्थाने वापरल्यास Article नाही.
examples: The honesty of the boy impressed everyone.

wrongRight.wrong: The honesty is the best policy.

rules.title: Material Noun (General)
rules.english: No article before material nouns in general sense.
rules.marathi: Material Noun सामान्य अर्थाने वापरल्यास Article नाही.
examples: The water in this bottle is dirty.

rules.title: Plural Noun (General)
rules.english: No article before plural nouns in general sense.
rules.marathi: Plural Noun सामान्य अर्थाने वापरल्यास Article नाही.
examples: The dogs in my house are friendly.

rules.title: Country Names
rules.english: Normally no article is used before country names, but THE is used for plural/union/kingdom/republic type names.
rules.marathi: देशांच्या नावांपूर्वी सामान्यतः Article वापरत नाही, पण Plural/Union/Kingdom/Republic प्रकारच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Organizations
rules.english: Use THE before important organizations.
rules.marathi: महत्त्वाच्या संस्थांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Titles & Designations
rules.english: Title + Name takes no article; Title alone takes THE.
rules.marathi: Title + Name असल्यास Article नाही; फक्त Title असल्यास The वापरतात.
examples: The Prime Minister addressed the nation.

rules.title: Few / A Few
rules.english: Few means almost none (negative); A few means some (positive). Used with countable nouns.
rules.marathi: Few = जवळजवळ नाही (Negative); A few = काही आहेत (Positive). Countable Noun सोबत वापरतात.

rules.title: Little / A Little
rules.english: Little means almost none (negative); A little means some (positive). Used with uncountable nouns.
rules.marathi: Little = जवळजवळ नाही (Negative); A little = थोडे आहे (Positive). Uncountable Noun सोबत वापरतात.

rules.title: Most
rules.english: Most in a general sense takes no article; The most before a particular group.
rules.marathi: सामान्य अर्थाने Most ला Article नाही; विशिष्ट गटासाठी The most वापरतात.
examples: The most students in this class...

rules.title: Next / Last
rules.english: Next/Last as time expressions take no article; The next/last for a specific sequence.
rules.marathi: Time Expression म्हणून Next/Last ला Article नाही; विशिष्ट क्रमासाठी The next/last वापरतात.

rules.title: Number Expressions
rules.english: Use A/An before number expressions like hundred, thousand, million, dozen.
rules.marathi: Hundred, Thousand, Million, Dozen यांपूर्वी A/An वापरतात.

rules.title: Mr / Mrs / Dr
rules.english: No article before Mr, Mrs, Dr with a name.
rules.marathi: Mr, Mrs, Dr नावासोबत असल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Body Parts
rules.english: THE is used after many verbs/prepositions referring to body parts.
rules.marathi: Body Parts साठी अनेक Verb/Preposition नंतर The वापरतात.
examples: He hit me on the head.
She caught me by the hand.
He was wounded in the leg.

rules.title: Time Expressions
rules.english: THE is used with morning, afternoon, evening; but no article with night in general.
rules.marathi: Morning, Afternoon, Evening सोबत The वापरतात; पण Night सामान्यतः Article शिवाय.

rules.title: Means of Communication
rules.english: Use THE with phone, radio, television as means of communication.
rules.marathi: Phone, Radio, Television साठी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Whole Class (The + Singular Noun)
rules.english: The + Singular Noun can represent the whole class.
rules.marathi: The + Singular Noun संपूर्ण वर्ग दर्शवते.

pyqTraps.right: The rich should help the poor.
The Prime Minister addressed the nation.

pyqTraps.wrong: He is in the hospital (treatment sense).
The honesty is the best policy.

examStrategy.english: Focus on the Sound Rule, high-frequency words (University, Honest, Hour, European, MBA), A/An + Profession, Abbreviations, Rivers, Oceans, Mountain Ranges, Superlatives, Musical Instruments and Ordinals.
examStrategy.marathi: Sound Rule सर्वात महत्त्वाचा. University, Honest, Hour, European, MBA वर PYQs वारंवार येतात. Rivers, Oceans, Mountain Ranges, Superlatives, Musical Instruments, Ordinals नक्की revise करा.

examStrategy.english: Revise pronunciation-based exceptions, fixed expressions, nationality, species, comparative pattern, qualified proper nouns, official posts and omission rules together.
examStrategy.marathi: Pronunciation-based exceptions, Fixed Expressions, Nationality, Species, Comparative Pattern, Qualified Proper Nouns, Official Posts आणि Omission Rules एकत्र revise करा.

goldenRevision: Languages, Subjects, Games, Meals, Days, Months, Festivals -> No Article
By Bus / By Train / By Air -> No Article
Go home / Go to bed / In hospital / Go to prison -> No Article
